reviews.review_description: Satisfaction from wo to go! When I asked for a quote, Jordan came round promptly and explained everything very clearly. We locked in, but needed to wait a week, to get all parts for the meter upgrade. When the guys came to install they were excellent, keeping us informed on what they were doing, and generally very friendly and professional-thanks Mark and Owen. They helped us set up the app. We will watch it for a few days, then try and get our heads around how it is all going, but so far, all good, and no glitches. Variety solar were a great company to work with, especially ensuring we got all 3 rebates, and no hidden extras.

So Variety Solar were excellent from the get go.Firstly and most importantly Jordan's product knowledge was 2nd to none.I love to reseach to death anything I buy, and so Jordan took multiple calls on numerous topics.  It was only after he had answered my 1000th questionsthat we bought the system.Whether it was discussing dc bi-directional charging and whether the module needed to be in the stack, my current usage compared to the battery size, the capability of the gateway, or the average distance in an install between a gas main and the battery, Jordan knew it all.  For the very few times I needed some future product information Jordan hooked me up with Sigenergy's national sales manager to discuss with the source.Then came the install and it was equally as good. Joseph came out on the weekend in his own time because I would not be there on the day of installation and took me through where each component would be installed.  He listened to everything I asked and hey presto when i came back from a work conference it was all done to spec.  Further Joseph and the team were lovely with my children and wife, fixed the internet which had dropped out and helped with another electrical problem we had.You could not do any better than these guys, and if you are like me and have a thirst for knowledge BEFORE you buy then Jordan is your guy.Thanks Variety Solar Team and a big thank-you to solar quotes for the referal.

We had a very positive experience going with Variety Solar.Jordan was extremely helpful  in understanding and finding the right system for us.Joseph and the Installation Team did a great job on the day, very thorough and friendly, including explaining the running of the system to us.It is early days but so far we are impressed with our Anker Solix system.

I had a 30kw battery system installed recently and a 6.4kw solar panel system installed almost 3 years ago.The panels and inverter have worked flawlessly since install, and the battery system has met expectations for the last 10 days or so (less than 1kw a day on average from the grid during a period of mostly cloud and rain).The sales and communication experience with Sam was very positive. The products were selected to meet my requirements with consideration for proven market quality, reliability and performance, and the quote was clear and accurate. Time commitments were met and small delays due to market demand were made clear at the beginning. I received several calls with updates and follow up to make sure everything was working.The electrical contractors for both jobs were exceptional. Friendly, helpful, on time, all the attributes you probably want to be confident with the install. A fault with one of the batteries (arrived not working) was sorted quickly and rectified within a few days.I honestly can't fault anything about the journey from initial contact to switching on the system.I recommend Variety Solar for both panel and battery systems without hesitation.
Quality install. In and out in a day. Cleaned up before they left. Very happy with final results

A bit of a long Journey from July 25 when signed proposal to getting the battery installed in October 25 but mostly due to shortage of stock due to Government rebates. Variety Solar did provide an alterative battery to prevent further delays which was appreciated and install was done without issue. Providing more regular updates to the customer and responding to more promptly is something would suggest improving on.
Customer service was fantastic.  Quote very professional. Installation was done professionally.

I'm very happy and satisfied with the fantastic service and workmanship from Variety Solar. From start to finish, the team made the entire process of installing our solar panel and battery system smooth, professional, and stress-free.Jordan was very knowledgeable and patient, answering all my questions and helping me choose the right system for our needs. The installation crew arrived on time, worked efficiently, and kept everything neat and tidy. I'm especially impressed with their attention to detail and the care they took to ensure everything was set up perfectly.Since the installation, our system has been running flawlessly and we’re already noticing the difference in our energy usage cost.A big thank-you to Solar Quotes for the recommendation and to the entire Variety Solar team for their outstanding service, high-quality products, and seamless installation. I highly recommend them to anyone considering solar — you’ll be in excellent hands!
Thanks to the team and Indris (electrician) for pulling of installing such a big system on time as desired. Can't be happier than that. Thanks to Vividh and Dylan for taking all my hassle as well.

Variety Solar did a great job with the installation of battery (having previously installed solar panels with them)The process was smooth from the start. I received a great price for the battery from them as well as a notice in advance that the battery will take few weeks to arrive since the demands are high at the moment which saves me time to ring them back again.Once battery arrived, it took less than a week for the installer to install it. Have to spend some additional dollers to install bollards and smoke detector for the compliance reason (battery in the garage) but was happy with the price I paid (well below the market price). Electrician assist me with the app functioning to easily charge the battery from grid if needed (off peak or night rates - time based control)Luckily, inspector came to inspect it next day (he was around the area) and did point out couple of small issues but happy with the installation (turn on the battery the same day). The electrician came the next business day and fix the issues.Battery runs smooth since then and let me save $$$ on the electricity.

Started to look for a quote in Jun and was recomended 2 installers from solarquotes.Got 1 quote initiallty but after speaking to Jordan, decided to go with Variety Solar as he explained a lot of details to me and was really patience in creating the various scenarios and combination possible for my home.Had to wait for the stock like most others and there was some confusion with the delivery but it was sorted before the installation date.Entire installation done in a single day, 13kw of new panels, 48kw of Sigenergy battery and the backup gateway and it was well done.Very lucky for me, inspector called the next day and did it on that day itself and system was up and running the same evening.I had a small set of panels before so the required meter was already in place and i got AUSNET's email the next day after the inspection.All good now except for a small issue and some question on the Sigenergy apps but the Jordan is helping to sort those out.Highly recommended.

The process was impressively quick from start to finish. Installation was smooth and professionally handled, with everything up and running in no time. Customer service was responsive, friendly and helpful throughout. Highly recommend for anyone considering solar battery solutions!

The quotations were prompt and follow-up with both parties was efficient. A slightly better knowledge of the preferred battery won the quote for Variety.  I think they run on a just in time model so were focused and keen to get payment ASAP.The installation despite being in rural Victoria was done by the contracted party (not subcontracted) who persevered until the job was completed - working long hours. The site was kept tidy. All the workers were very polite and had time to explain what they were doing (especially the senior installer).The battery has just been inspected so it's a little early to see how some of  our questions about implementation will b e addressed but I am optimistic.

I actually reached out to variety solar a year or so ago to expands my battery. It didn't make sense then to install. So I contacted Jordan again this tielme with rebates and he not only remembered my issue but went above and beyond to get the best outcome for my situation. He was patient and thorough throughout the discovery process.  In the end got some battery modules installed and they were installed very smoothly detailing the steps along the way. Satisfied with the install, price and service.

Got a 13.2kw system installed in May.  We had a battery installed last week and developed a problem with our solar system not long after.  I called Variety and received prompt response and were going to send out an electrician when we realised it may have been a battery initiated problem.  Turned out it was.Even though the fault was nothing to do with Variety their phone support was excellent.How good post sales support is an indicator of how good the company really is and Variety are excellent.

I had Longi panels installed with a Goodwe inverter.Vividh explained everything to me in detail.Dilan from the operations team kept me updated throughout the job scheduling process.Their installer, Joseph, did a fantastic and clean job.They submitted all the paperwork on time, although Jemena took three weeks for the grid connection  which was beyond their control.The team followed up very promptly.The system is working perfectly.I’m very happy with their service.
Thanks Jordan for helping make the decision to go with you guys .Great work by Joesph and the team who did a wonderful job highly recommend.

I was all set to go with another provider. Jordan the sales person was excellent. Helpful in explaining things without the over the top sleazy sales pitch (we're helping you out etc, you have to sign with us, only we can do it properly) you can feel from other sales people. He was polite and answered every question I had. The price was the best of the three I got quotes from. The install occurred a week or so later, so quick turn around time. A note that Variety seem to be an aggregator, they order the gear and sub out the install. It was a little annoying they wanted to and did deliver the materials a few days before install, they are large and you need a safe place for these to be kept. The installers left all of their rubbish here, which I was not pleased with. The post install inspection took 3 weeks, which is completely unacceptable IMO. I was told usually a week from the installer, that then turned into 2, and at the 3 week mark I rang to complain again. The inspector came the next day. The 3 week wait post inspection with multiple follow ups put a real sour taste to the whole experience, it would certainly make me think twice about using them again in the future.The system itself has been great, the most I've generated is about 5-6kwh in one go, 20-25KWH per day. Given this is in a Melbourne winter, I think these numbers are great.

Although the sales and quoting process was quite good the service after that was disappointing. The initial contact with installer was positive but he could not complete the job on the day and it took a few phone calls to both him and the company for the job to be completed.  You had to leave messages with both as they did not answer the phone.  It took 2 weeks to finish the installation.  Finally after 1 month from date of giving the go ahead the is up and running.  Very frustrating.  I am happy with the system but not the company I purchased it from.

Great service initially with the sales team. Few hiccups along the way. But overall job has been completed and I am happy with the system. Slightly dearer than competitors but the sales teams service and knowledge gave me trust in their company.

Provider had a good knowledge about product and he explained all financial criteria to go through with solar Victoria to get VIC rebates. And explain all different brands in market according to fit to your pocket.Service was quick.

We installed a 13.2kW system with Longi panels and a GoodWe inverter. Installer Joseph and his team did a fantastic job, handling the tough two-story installation with great attention to safety.The entire process was smooth, and customer service was excellent from start to finish.I highly recommend Variety Solar.Vividh and his team are truly professional and reliable.Thanks to the Variety Solar.Specially thanks to VIVIDH and his Team.Regards,Foram Patel.
Watch out for connectivity as the supplier Variety Solar  and AusNet can not get it sorted.

The process was simple.  I actually contacted more than the 3 that were recommended and on the end the price and system that I was interested in after checking solar quotes info on the web won me over. The company offered various choices as to where to put the panels till we decided on a final place. The installers had years of experience and I will highly recommend them. They did a great job and kept us involved with what they were doing.
2nd lowest price. Installation occurred on agreed date. Installers helped set up app on iPad.
Sales process was fantastic. Every part was clearly explainedInstallation was tidy and punctualAll application paper works were done and completed on time

Sam was great at following up my enquiry and any questions. Quote was detailed and comprehensive. Installation team were polite and helpful. System has been up and running. Showed me how to use the app.

Sam from Variety Solar is very professional and knowledgeable. A minor incident pre installation where some panels fell onto the ground, were immediately replaced without question. This is what you pay for, when there are issues you want them resolved and Sam was very accommodating. I've had the system working for over a month now and highly recommend going with Variety Solar.

I requested a "Site Assessment" prior to deciding on who I was going to select.Variety Solar sent Installer/Electrician without any committment or obligation, this was the favour tipping action.Other potential suppliers wanted signatures & other commitments (even payment)
Everything went smoothly and very happy with quality of the system and the tradespeople involvedGreat communication and excellent value for money

First time owner of the solar system, and am glad to be introduced to Variety Solar. With their friendly and attentive staff, provided me professional advice that allows me to decide the best system for my homes.Installation and commissioning process was done professionally, and the installers took additional effort to tidy up the area and assisted us with addressing minor neighbour complaints on site.Inquiries about the solar system, installation, commissioning and grid connection were addressed promptly and most of the time able to be resolved fully.
Jordan and the entire team were helpful and they did a great job with the Solar installation, highly recommended.

I went for the Melbourne-based installer Variety Solar out of 3 quotes recommended by SQ and a fourth from a local firm. The other quotes were all regional installers. Variety Solar offered best value for money and was within our budget. Collecting the quotes was a positive experience as all the installers were ready to discuss my needs and revise their quotes if necessary to meet my preferences.The installation took a bit longer than expected but this was not the installer's fault - the main delays were caused by a spell of bad weather and a fault in the inverter shipped by Sungrow (which was difficult to detect but an easy fix). The installer's 2.5 hour drive from Melbourne did contribute to the delay. The subcontracted electrician installers were very professional and a pleasure to deal with - responsive to my requests and keeping me up to date as they worked through the installation.Sam at Variety Solar was excellent as my contact throughout the process - from the quoting through to connection to the grid. He made regular contact to answer my frequent questions and ensure that I was satisfied with the installation.My initial intention was to select an installer from within my region but I am happy with my cost-based decision to go with a Melbourne-based installer and I would certainly recommend Variety Solar to anyone else.

I recently had a solar installation done, and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The entire process was very professional and swift. My main contact, Jordan, was exceptional. He answered all my questions promptly and made sure I felt informed every step of the way.Joseph, the chief electrician, was also fantastic. He was hands-on throughout the installation and went above and beyond to ensure everything was done correctly. He took the time to explain the expectations and processes to me, which really put my mind at ease.Overall, I highly recommend this team to anyone considering solar installation. I will definitely be sharing my positive experience with friends and family!
Choice of various systems, able to mix and match. All good so far.
Sales guy "Simon" was great.Installation went really well, guys were very pleasant and helpful.Customer service also worked very well.

I recently decided to install Enphase IQ 5P batteries to store the excess energy produced by my solar panels. Variety Solar was one of the three companies recommended by SolarQuotes. They were the first company to contact me and the only one that recommended that I enlarge my solar array to get the most out of the batteries. The extra panels and batteries were installed within 5 days from the day I accepted their quote. Vividh Shah and his team organised for all the hardware to be delivered the day after I accepted their quote. Their installer, Jason Costanzo, was onsite the following day. He was very professional and patiently answered all my questions. Jason and Gawishkar did a very neat installation over the next couple of days and tidied up before leaving. The new system was seamlessly integrated into my existing system. I am very grateful for the excellent service and expert advice I received from both Vividh and Jason and would unhesitatingly recommend them to anyone who may be considering installing solar panels and/or batteries.

Jordan from the Variety Solar team really went the extra mile to ensure that he provided us with the best possible solar and battery solution from quote through to install. He thoughtfully took into account all of our requirements which included disconnecting from gas and switching to induction cooking and heat pump hot water as part of the installation. He coordinated everything and provided advice throughout which made our lives easier and meant we were able to take full advantage of our new solar plant right away.The installation team headed up by Joseph were also great, delivering a really neat and professional job, even the inspector was impressed! Joseph made sure we understood how our new installation works including explaining our new switchboard and helping us to setup the app to track our solar plant.All in all, a great job guys - we're very happy.

I recently had a 6.6kw solar system installed by Variety Solar.Vividh has been great to deal with throughout the whole process .He was available to all my question throughout the whole process, making it easy for me to make informed decisions.Vividh and his wonderful installation team were all very professional.I highly recommend Variety Solar to anyone looking to get a new solar system.Thank again Vividh

Great support with the offer and sign up. Installation took a little longer than I hoped but the communication was great and I know a lot more about the system because of this. This was an extension to the existing solar with more than doubling of panels and a first battery install. Because of the location I have south and east facing panels now-which yesterday gave more power than the original north and west facing ones.

Jordan from variety solar helped me with all my enquires and needs for my solar system, accompanied with great pricing, and  from someone who has a back ground in the industry great installation they went above and beyond. Thanks again for the quick installation.

Jordan was very accomodating and honest with all the questions i have asked, he coordinate things very efficiently even after hours. Jordan have recommended solar panel and inverter which have good performance and value for your money.  Have assured me this will be install within two weeks time and they did deliver!!The sales process provided by Variety Solar was very professional and is within my budget. Installation was then provided by the Positive Sparky team who were on time, polite and friendly, and communicative. My property was left clean and tidy with follow up installation assessment arranged and grid connection organised. The system is now on line and operating really well.Well Done Variety Solar team!!

The quoting and sales process were excellent.  Our contact Sam was more than helpful.  Installation was well done and finished in a tidy manner.  Layer follow up by the installer and Sam addressing an issue with the battery was rapid and completed in an efficient manner.  A great experience.

quoting process took lots of time as lots of information was passed down and brimmed me with advices and suggestions which is good. installers were very nice and polite and went up n above to do fabulous and clean job. they provided informations on solar app, about grid power loss, smoke detectors etc.

Jordan at Variety Solar was an exceptional Salesperson: he listened to our requirements, sent me off to improve on my own research and explained the benefits of installing a larger battery as well as the Solar Panels, answered all of my questions, explained the whole process and was flexible with taking my return calls and provided multiple quotes, then explained the options clearly so that I was able to choose a system that suited our needs.The Equipment was delivered efficiently. Joseph and his installation team were exceptional: tidy, punctual and explained everything very clearly and ensured that the Inspection was completed within the 2-week period after installation.Overall, we are very happy with Variety Solar and would recommend them to others
Ontime installation and great customer service from sales, delivery and installation

Good work. Jordan coordinated the work really well. He was honest which I liked and read the lay of the roof quickly to tell me that all panels can fit in nicely on the northern side.Jason who installed the panels was a knowledgeable guy who also did a good job

Great communication from the office, very thorough supply of information from Jordan, so many options and we are very happy with the solution we settled on, Excellent support from the office during the install, sadly our installer was not reliable in terms of punctuality, and was not a good communicator, a couple of times didn’t turn up as planned, I understand tradies are busy, but he just needed to call.On the positive side his work quality was impeccable, and of the highest quality. We opted to upgrade our ancient ‘fuse’ board at the same time to have modern safety switches on all circuits. Carried out with no issues.

We highly recommend Variety Solar. Right from the start Shuey Diptiman helped us every step of the way. Was happy to answer all our questions. Josef the installer was helpful, punctual and knowledgeable. Great company. Thank you.
Very pleasant to deal with and a great high quality installation

Throughout the process I asked a lot of questions.  All the companies Finn recommended were patient and accommodating when I kept changing the design being quoted.Ultimately I ended up going for what I thought was the right system at the cheapest price possible.The system was installed within 1 week of finalising the quote and the installers were fantastic doing such a tidy job. They did end up taking two days to install which was no problem as I was working from home.The only negative was the specific details of the system design e.g. placement of the inverter and the removal of the old solar panels was not explained to the installers even though they were written on the quote. Thankfully I had this discussion with the installers before any work was started and they put everything where I wanted.I would definitely recommend Variety Solar as they did a fantastic job.
Great customer service and a quick install and information  provided made the decision easier
Variety solar have done a great job from start to finish

The sales process provided by Variety Solar was very professional with six detailed options designed for my needs provided. Installation was then provided by the Positive Sparky team who were on time, polite and friendly, and communicative. My property was left clean and tidy with follow up installation assessment arranged and grid connection organised. The system is now on line and operating as expected.

Very happy with the system. Joseph the installer was fantastic and would highly recommend. Arrived on time with his team in the early morning and stayed late to get it all done in one day. Very helpful and knowledgeable. Prior and after installation Vividh was always courteous and available and organised the grid conenction.

Quoting process was great, Jordan updated the quotes multiple times in order to reflect the perfect system for me.Installation was great, the team cleaned up everything after they were finished.Customer service i would rate 8/10, quoting team were perfect however when it was passed to the installation team i had to be proactive in contacting them.Overall a great experience and i would recommend Variety Solar

Jordan gave 5 fantastic quotes with various options on size and quality. Matt did a very neat job installing as well as a good clean up when finished. Customer service was good and they did organize grid connection.

The initial quote was good and selected them due to the significant cost saving, their assurances that they could do the job at short notice and the good review here and on other sites. The problems started once I had signed-off. Long Delays and after 4 weeks of being told "do not worry" and "ït is coming" but not provided with any timeline on what and when was coming next, I was then rang by what I understood to be the sales manager to explain that they had underquoted and that I would need to have to pay a significant additional amount.Due to personal time pressures and already wasting a month waiting, I decided to continue with them and to come to an agreement on the additional amount. Then I started seeing a some activity with some guys come by to have a look at the job. A local installer picked up the role and to his credit was able to fit me in at short notice. The equipment arrived and it seemed that the wrong (and cheaper) invertor had been sent.  The day of the install, the installation team did work hard and the main electrician was very knowledgeable and looks like he did a good job. Unfortunately a few weeks later, I realised that the apprentice had left a big mess in the roof space with having ripped my roof sarking in a number of places and pulling it away from the roof in others with out patching it, taking me a few hours to patch it all up when discovered.Another issue was when I wanted to change the Wifi connection point, the team lead would not engage me via a number of emails to assist in proving me with the right authorisation to be able to change WIFI settings. Fortunately, not having paid the invoice till this was resolved helped motivate a response.Lastly, the invoice arrived soon after the final inspection with Nett30 days on it and from this naturally assumed I had 30 days to pay.... but then started to get hassled to pay immediately.. After the delays experienced at the beginning of the process, I was     tempted to delay the payment, but saw no reason to delay once the Wifi issues were dealt with.Another issue was that during the whole process, people would just turn up or be told they are about to turn-up with the expectation that I would be home. On one occasion where they had to swap out the invertor, I was not home, but fortunately someone was, who could assist.The upshot is although the installer seems to have done a good job overall (other than the mess left behind in the roof), based on a month of running and from the reports I can see, the front office function should really review their processes and communications and ensure that those providing the quote, are sufficiently trained in provided the right quote first time.I Hope this helps others.

The whole process was very painless. The Variety Solar salesperson listened to what I wanted instead of trying to sell what he thought I wanted! He understood that what he initially proposed (5 options) would need to be confirmed by a site inspection; he arranged for an installation team leader to do the necessary measurements technical checks. This resulted in a much more accurate quote. Because I chose top quality products (thanks Solar Quotes for the reviews) the outcome was not cheap, but met all of my requirements. The installation was also very well handled and utterly professional. The wrong batteries had been delivered which resulted in a delay in finalisation of the installation. Once the correct batteries were delivered, staff arrived within an hour of my notification to finalise everything.

Sam was great to talk to. Very informative and in simple language. No pressure. Once approved installation was quick and efficient with avery friendly crew. Cleaned up and left everything tidy. Very happy.
All good, The installer took one day to install all 20 panels and the electrician connected all parts and tested good

The quoting process was fact and professional . As far as the installation goes, I couldn’t asked for anymore that what I got, top guys The grid connection has been organised and waiting for AGL to do their upgrade on their end
Knowledgeable sales person, flexible installers who were professional and courteous.  Very happy to recommend.

Variety Solar came out slightly ahead of the other recommended installers. They were all very helpful, and very close in their quotes so it came down to very small details. I would recommend them all if I could!Variety Solar offered a range of different quotes - different value panels and inverters, different sizes - to make it clearer for me to make an informed choice.They were very helpful with any questions I had, and were able to explain anything that was confusing to me as someone with no knowledge of solar systems.The installers were excellent. They were happy to explain what they were doing, answer any questions and advise me what would happen after the installation. They were also very clean and tidy leaving no mess behind.

We had taken quotes from 4 different solar providers, and Variety Solar stood out from the start. Jordan was super helpful in helping us understand the ins and outs, and on top the price they offered was much lower to what other vendors had quoted.Installation itself was a breeze, and we were kept posted on everything.

Variety solar beat my cheapest quote and included higher quality Jinko panels. Jordan provided all the info required to make an informed decision and communicated on my terms (mostly via SMS!).The installers were exceptionally thorough and ensured the install was going to provide the best performance from the solar and battery system.Didn’t think I’d even be able to afford a battery so am so chuffed with the result. Would highly recommend variety based on my experience.
From the first phone conversation all the way to the installation. They were great. I can not fault them.They even dealt with my electricity supplier for me5/5

From the initial contact from Ekansh and the complete process, this was a seamless installation for my system.The back office were also great dealing with network providers and my supplier to get me hooked up to the grid the day after install.I can not fault my experience at all.

Ekansh was very helpful with recommending a system to fit my budget.Very competitive pricing and prompt scheduling of installation.Backend paperwork was handle well and feed in tariff required little input to arrange from power company.

Jordan was great explaining all the options - string inverters, optimisers, micro-inverters. Their price was the cheapest of the 3 quotes, and the salesperson seemed the most knowledgeable.When the delivery was made the micro-inverters were delayed coming from Sydney, so the installers turned up the following day all ready to go and could only get as far as putting the racks on the roof. The inverters arrived two days later.I had to follow up a couple of times to find out when the installers would come back to finish the job. It was 10 days from their initial visit (no doubt they had a full schedule to juggle). They worked an extremely long day and by the end of it, everything was set up. 3 days later the inspector arrived and we now have a great working system.

Ekansh from Variety Solar was amazing as soon as I had a question about the installation or the products he immediately replied even after I’d signed the contract and paid the deposit.  He confirmed with me the install would be done the day after settlement of the property and to my surprise they turned up on time and completed it that daySam the contractor was amazing and when the Independent electrician attended to sign off on the Job he commented he had seen his work before and it is always top notch which he confirmed after he got down from the roofWould highly recommend Variety Solar and the contractor Engaged electrical

The sales person from Variety was friendly and wasn't pushy like some of the others. He wanted to make sure I had a good understanding of the panels and inverters and was happy to give me a range of options and revisions when I wanted to make changes. Once I had decided to proceed, they were quick to arrange an installation date as soon as the Vic solar rebate was approved. On installation day, the installers were excellent and when there was a small issue with the invoice the customer service people were quick to rectify. There were some unavoidable delays with connection to the grid (this was happening around Christmas/New Year public holidays and on top of that the power distributor in the area had a fault with their web portal) but it went through as soon as possible after this. All up, I had a great experience with Variety and would recommend them to others.

Jordan from Variety Solar Pty Ltd was the only sales agent that made the effort to explain the nuances of having a solar system installed. The first phone consultation was nothing short of educational for me as a customer without any knowledge of brands or specifications to look for. He was also prompt to respond to further inquiries during the entire process.The installation team was punctual, professional, and accommodating of particular demands we had as far as placement of battery and panels were concerned. They worked hard under the unrelenting heat from 8 am to 4 pm  to get both panels and battery working. I wouldn't hesitate recommending this company in the future! A++

Jordan was most helpful in explaining options and we locked in the system that suited us first. Communication was easy. The team headed by Joseph the Electrician did a fantastic job. Joseph was great in setting us up and explaining everything. We are very happy.

The sales process was timely and provided good information.The installation process was excellent - Idris & Mahmood take great pride in their work and this shows in the results.The whole system was inspected promptly after installation and it's all good.Great work.

Great customer service and value for money.Jordan did an excellent job with info. He was available whenever I had a question and understood that I needed to take time to make my decision. A great help with advice about what would work for me.The installer team led by Idris (ask for him if you can) was equally great. The team was super professional, hard working, polite and helped set up all the monitoring apps.Definitely recommend.

This has been a great experience from quote to installation. Ekansh was extremely helpful with with the specification of our system, quotation, helpful with VIC state rebate and coordination of the installation. Delivery of the system, installation and grid connection happened on consecutive days. A big thank you to all involved at Variety Solar.

Jordan was and still is very helpful and detailed on options available, explaining each option thoroughly, spent time returning and answering all questions.installers were prompt, polite and helpful.everything to do with the purchase and install has gone well
Multiple choice base on budget.Installation went smoothly without issue.

Variety Solar has a competent and passionate sales advisor. He was thoughtfully considering options to meet my requirements and i trusted him with my business.Variety Solar were a well oiled machine -responding rapidly to my pre-Xmas install within 1 week of my contract commitment--that's good service!The independent solar inspector said thay had done a good job of the install--it took 3 of them a whole day to install 13.2KW & 2 inverters.

Jordan was an excellent sales person from start to finish. Despite delays on our end, Jordan was great with communication and getting everything organised.  Would definitely recommend Jordan and the company for any future installations in my social circle.
Great experience from Quote to Installation. Fast & reliable, did exactly what they promised. Very happy with performance of the system
They didn’t wasted my time and knew what is allowed on my single phase house. I liked their pricing and quick installation.
The sales and quoting process was seamless.Salesperson was responsive.Installation went well.Customer service was effective and organised everything well.
Easy sales and quoting processInstallation was timely, and the guys were polite.Customer service is easily reachable and helpful.
